comparison.objective: Cut a cable tie off a cable bundle without damaging insulation.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a bundle, position flush cutters around a narrow strap, squeeze to sever it, and return the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Tie severed and removed, insulation undamaged, bundle/tool restored and arms withdrawn; any nick scores zero.
comparison.reason: Precision cutting near vulnerable cables has no meaningful overlap with granular separation.
